comment: Cite or Silence. Problem first, then sell. `at` is the second the line starts.

lines.text: You ever get asked a question on a call, and now you're flipping through tabs while the whole room waits?
Maybe you don't know the answer. Or maybe you do, but you want to double-check before you say it out loud.
Either way, everyone's just sitting there.
Well, you don't have to do that anymore.
You give it your projects. Code, docs, contracts — whatever you're going to get asked about.
It goes through all of it in your browser. Nothing gets uploaded anywhere.
Then when the question comes up, you just ask. MeetHint pulls the exact line, and tells you the file and the lines.
So you're not guessing. You're reading it.
It uses a language model so you can say exactly what needs to be said.
And here's the part I actually like.
If the answer isn't in your files, it doesn't make something up. The card just stays empty.
It either cites it, or it stays quiet.
Turn on listen mode and it follows the call. Overlay it on your second monitor.
You ever get asked something on a call and start digging through tabs? Yeah.
MeetHint pulls the exact line. Nothing uploaded.
If it's not in your files, it stays quiet.
